armor.description: car bumper. for bumping back.

designs.victory_message: the crusher jammed! its stuck open! no more crushing!
designs.defeat_message: the crusher made you into a cube. a very flat cube.

boss.name: Tire King
boss.description: hes a TOWER of tires. he rolls at you. FAST.

weapon.name: Tire Iron
weapon.description: for removing tires. or FIGHTING.

armor.name: Inner Tube Armor
armor.description: bouncy! boing!

designs.victory_message: the tire king popped! PSSSSHHHH! flat!
designs.defeat_message: the tire king rolled over you. flat as a pancake.

boss.name: The Controller
boss.description: he controls ALL the machines. he has the key card AND a big red button.

weapon.name: Big Wrench
weapon.description: for turning OFF machines

armor.name: Hard Hat
armor.description: safety first. even in combat.

designs.victory_message: you hit the OFF switch! all the machines stopped! you got the key card!
designs.defeat_message: the controller pressed the red button. you dont wanna know what it does.

boss.name: The Trash Titan
boss.description: ALL THE JUNK IN THE YARD IS ONE MONSTER NOW. biggest orange square. hes got washing machine fists and car door wings and tire legs and HES HUGE.

weapon.name: Magnet Cannon
weapon.description: pulls him APART piece by piece!

armor.name: Titan Plate
armor.description: made from the STRONGEST junk

designs.victory_message: THE TRASH TITAN FELL APART!! JUST A BIG PILE OF JUNK AGAIN!! RECYCLE THAT!!
designs.defeat_message: the trash titan added you to his body. youre his left pinky now.

overworld.name: Volcano Fortress
overworld.description: theres a fortress INSIDE a volcano and the fire army lives there and theyre NOT nice!

levels.name: Lava Moat
levels.description: theres lava instead of water around the fortress. dont fall in.
levels.theme: lava moat, stone bridge, fire archers, heat shimmer

levels.name: Ember Barracks
levels.description: this is where the fire soldiers sleep. they dont sleep though.
levels.theme: barracks, fire bunks, ember soldiers, weapon racks

levels.name: Magma Forge
levels.description: they MAKE weapons here. out of LAVA. thats metal. literally.
levels.theme: forge, lava anvils, fire hammers, molten weapons

levels.name: The Fire Pit
levels.description: just a big pit of fire. bad guys push you toward it.
levels.theme: fire pit arena, ring of flames, push traps, heat waves

levels.name: The War Room
levels.description: the generals plan attacks here. one has the key card.
levels.theme: war room, fire maps, strategy table, lava lamps (literally)

levels.name: The Fire Lords Chamber
levels.description: THE FIRE LORD IS IN HERE. biggest orange square. HES LITERALLY ON FIRE ALL THE TIME.
levels.theme: fire throne, lava falls, flame crown, inferno chamber

boss.name: Bridge Guardian
boss.description: he stands on the bridge and says YOU SHALL NOT PASS. original.

weapon.name: Ice Arrow
weapon.description: pshew! sizzle! right in the fire.

armor.name: Stone Shield
armor.description: wont melt. unlike everything else here.

designs.victory_message: the bridge guardian fell off his own bridge! into the lava! ironic!
designs.defeat_message: you shall not pass. he was right.

boss.name: Fire Sergeant
boss.description: he yells SO LOUD his voice is fire. literally fire voice.

weapon.name: Fire Blanket
weapon.description: throw it on them and WHOMP fire gone

armor.name: Asbestos Vest
armor.description: fire resistant. very resistant.

designs.victory_message: the fire sergeant lost his voice! just a whisper now! heh!
designs.defeat_message: the fire sergeant yelled you into next week. on fire.

boss.name: Master Smith
boss.description: he makes THE best fire weapons. now hes making one for YOUR face.

weapon.name: Frost Hammer
weapon.description: cold iron. every fire guys weakness.

armor.name: Forge Apron
armor.description: industrial strength. fire proof.

designs.victory_message: the master smith quenched himself! SIZZLE! hes cool now! temperature cool!
designs.defeat_message: the master smith forged you into a sword. youre a sword now.

boss.name: Pit Champion
boss.description: hes never lost. because he pushes everyone in the pit.

weapon.name: Push Pole
weapon.description: NO. YOU go in the pit!

armor.name: Anchor Boots
armor.description: NOBODY can push you in these!

designs.victory_message: the pit champion fell in his OWN pit! push karma!
designs.defeat_message: into the fire pit. its very warm. too warm. way too warm.

boss.name: Fire General
boss.description: he has the key card AND a fire sword AND a fire horse. triple threat.

weapon.name: Generals Own Sword
weapon.description: wait you stole HIS sword?? bold.

armor.name: War Plate
armor.description: generals armor. fancy AND strong.

designs.victory_message: the fire general surrendered! you got the LAST white square!
designs.defeat_message: the fire general outstrategized you. you got outstrategized.

boss.name: The Fire Lord
boss.description: HES ON FIRE. ALL OF HIM. biggest orange square AND hes on FIRE. fire orange square. double orange.

weapon.name: Blizzard Blade
weapon.description: THE coldest sword. makes it SNOW when you swing it!

armor.name: Absolute Zero Armor
armor.description: SO cold the fire lord cant even get NEAR you

designs.victory_message: THE FIRE LORD GOT EXTINGUISHED!! PSHHHH!! THE VOLCANO IS COOLING DOWN!!
designs.defeat_message: the fire lord is too hot. everything is fire now. everything.

overworld.name: Cloud Kingdom
overworld.description: way WAY up in the clouds theres a whole kingdom and the giants live there!

levels.name: Beanstalk Top
levels.description: you climbed the beanstalk! the clouds are SOLID up here!
levels.theme: beanstalk top, cloud ground, giant world entrance

levels.name: Giant Kitchen
levels.description: everything is SO BIG. the table is like a building.
levels.theme: giant table, huge utensils, crumb mountains, spilled milk lake

levels.name: Golden Egg Room
levels.description: the goose that lays golden eggs is here. the giants guard it.
levels.theme: golden nest, giant goose, egg piles, guard posts

levels.name: Fee Fi Fo Hall
levels.description: the giants stomp around saying FEE FI FO FUM. the floor shakes.
levels.theme: giant hallway, massive footprints, shaking everything

levels.name: Harp Chamber
levels.description: the magic harp plays music and it puts you to SLEEP if youre not careful. key card is here.
levels.theme: harp room, magical music, sleeping guards, locked cage

levels.name: Giant King Throne
levels.description: THE GIANT KING IS SO BIG HE CANT EVEN FIT IN THE ROOM. biggest orange square. like REALLY biggest.
levels.theme: giant throne room, clouds for walls, enormous everything

boss.name: Beanstalk Guard
boss.description: he guards the top of the beanstalk. hes only a SMALL giant.

weapon.name: Bean Shooter
weapon.description: shoots magic beans! PEW!

armor.name: Leaf Plate
armor.description: giant beanstalk leaves. very tough.

designs.victory_message: the beanstalk guard went back down the beanstalk! bye!
designs.defeat_message: the guard threw you off the cloud. its a LONG way down.

boss.name: Kitchen Giant
boss.description: she cooks things. she wants to cook YOU.

weapon.name: Butter Knife
weapon.description: giant sized but you use it like a big sword

armor.name: Thimble Armor
armor.description: its giant sized so its like real armor for you!

designs.victory_message: the kitchen giant burned her soup and ran to fix it! go go go!
designs.defeat_message: the kitchen giant put you in the soup. seasoning.

boss.name: Golden Goose Guard
boss.description: he protects the goose. he has a GIANT club.

weapon.name: Golden Egg Bomb
weapon.description: throw it and CRACK! gold explosion!

armor.name: Golden Egg Shield
armor.description: solid gold egg shell. fancy.

designs.victory_message: the guard fell asleep! the goose is free! HONK!
designs.defeat_message: the golden goose sat on you. golden and heavy.

boss.name: Fee Fi Fo Giant
boss.description: he says FEE FI FO FUM and each word makes the ground SHAKE

weapon.name: Ankle Biter
weapon.description: you can only reach his ankles but it WORKS

armor.name: Anti-Shake Boots
armor.description: you stay standing no matter what!

designs.victory_message: the giant stubbed his toe SO hard he sat down crying!
designs.defeat_message: FEE FI FO FUM. he found you. you know how this ends.

boss.name: Harp Guardian
boss.description: she plays music that makes you sleepy. yawn... NO STAY AWAKE!

weapon.name: Loud Horn
weapon.description: HONK! nobody can sleep through THAT!

armor.name: Earplugs Plus
armor.description: you cant hear the sleep music!

designs.victory_message: you broke the harp! the key card fell out of it! CLANG!
designs.defeat_message: the music was too pretty. you fell asleep. zzzzz forever.

boss.name: The Giant King
boss.description: HES SO BIG. LIKE SO SO SO BIG. biggest orange square. you cant even SEE all of him at once.

weapon.name: Jack's Axe
weapon.description: THE axe. for cutting beanstalks AND fighting giants!

armor.name: Giant Slayer Suit
armor.description: makes you AS STRONG as a giant!

designs.victory_message: THE GIANT KING FELL THROUGH THE CLOUDS!! FEE FI FO... AAAAHH!! THE CLOUD KINGDOM IS SAVED!!
designs.defeat_message: the giant king flicked you. ONE finger. flick. youre gone.

overworld.name: Time Machine
overworld.description: you got a TIME MACHINE and you go to different times and theres bad guys in EVERY time!

levels.name: Dinosaur Time
levels.description: youre back with the dinosaurs AGAIN! but this time theres cave people too!
levels.theme: prehistoric, dinosaurs AND cavemen, volcanoes, ferns

levels.name: Knight Time
levels.description: its the middle ages! knights and castles and dragons oh my!
levels.theme: medieval castle, knights, jousting, catapults

levels.name: Pirate Time
levels.description: ARRR its the pirate age! ships and treasure and parrots!
levels.theme: pirate ships, treasure maps, skull flags, cannon smoke

levels.name: Robot Future
levels.description: the future has robots. LOTS of robots. and flying cars.
levels.theme: futuristic city, neon, robots, hover vehicles, chrome

levels.name: Time Prison
levels.description: somebody is TRAPPING time travelers. the key card is in the time lock.
levels.theme: time prison, clocks everywhere, frozen people, time locks

levels.name: The Time King
levels.description: HE CONTROLS ALL OF TIME. biggest orange square. he exists in EVERY time at once. how??
levels.theme: time throne, all eras visible, clock gears, temporal storm

boss.name: Cave Boss
boss.description: hes a caveman with a REALLY big club. unga bunga!

weapon.name: Bone Club
weapon.description: a dino bone. again. still works!

armor.name: Mammoth Fur
armor.description: warm and tough!

designs.victory_message: the cave boss ran away from your time machine! too scary for him!
designs.defeat_message: the cave boss thought you were food. cave people are not picky.

boss.name: Evil Knight
boss.description: his armor is all black and spiky. VERY evil looking.

weapon.name: Knight Sword
weapon.description: shiny and sharp! for justice!

armor.name: Shield of Time
armor.description: it has a clock on it. looks cool.

designs.victory_message: the evil knight got knocked off his horse! clang clang clang!
designs.defeat_message: the evil knight jousted you. OFF the horse. OFF the castle. OFF.

boss.name: Time Pirate
boss.description: hes a pirate FROM THE FUTURE. he has a laser sword AND a parrot.

weapon.name: Laser Cutlass
weapon.description: half pirate half future! PEW ARRR!

armor.name: Future Pirate Coat
armor.description: it has a force field. and gold buttons.

designs.victory_message: the time pirate sailed into a TIME HOLE! arrr goodbye!
designs.defeat_message: the time pirate sent you to the wrong time. good luck.

boss.name: Future Cop
boss.description: he has ALL the future weapons. stun gun, net gun, time gun.

weapon.name: Time Blaster
weapon.description: shoots time at people! they get REALLY confused!

armor.name: Chrome Armor
armor.description: shiny and from the FUTURE

designs.victory_message: the future cop got confused by his own time gun! haha!
designs.defeat_message: the future cop arrested you for time crimes. time jail.

boss.name: Time Warden
boss.description: he freezes time. and he has the LAST key card. in frozen time.

weapon.name: Time Hammer
weapon.description: unfreezes stuff when you HIT it!

armor.name: Time Proof Vest
armor.description: time freeze doesnt work on you!

designs.victory_message: the time warden unfroze! and gave you the key card! time is moving again!
designs.defeat_message: the time warden froze you. for a MILLION years.

boss.name: The Time King
boss.description: HE EXISTS IN ALL TIMES!! biggest orange square in ALL of history!! past present AND future!!

weapon.name: THE CLOCK SWORD
weapon.description: it ticks when you swing it! TICK SLASH TOCK SLASH!

armor.name: ARMOR OF ALL TIMES
armor.description: has pieces from EVERY time period! cave fur AND knight plate AND future chrome!

designs.victory_message: THE TIME KING EXPLODED INTO ALL THE TIMES!! PAST BOOM!! PRESENT BOOM!! FUTURE BOOM!! TIME IS SAVED!!
designs.defeat_message: the time king erased you from time. you never existed. wait what?
